column1: # Rulings on this pair, kept by hand. refuse with both sides: that shape is never a link, whatever proposes it (source: only from that source). refuse with one side and a source: those words leave that source's rows. accept: the shape is pinned and wins every competition.

column6: 2 Samuel 23:38 «Іра їтрянин, Ґарев їтрянин»: Ґарев is Gareb (KJV word 4), not the second 'Ithrite' (word 6); the aligner remade on 2026-11-12 (PRB-1588) pairs it with the gentilic.
